description: After tx_step_down_waits answer waits in a row with no answer, the sender steps down one rung by itself, below the peer's recommendation.
note: Link setup as dts-arq/ack-wait-expiry-retransmit: conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ, its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST 'open' to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 makes the CAS call (request at 75000 at drc.default_speed, WN 2 Long, EOW EMPTY to a peer of unknown edition), and at 91000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED makes the link (16-bit family) and records the peer Ed4 (B-0408). That D_PDU's EOW is MAX-SPEED WN 4 Long (0x8A4: interleaver 101, speed 4), recorded (interp C-1262). On D_CONNECTION_MADE the rung the link was made at, drc.default_speed, position 0, counts as the last answered (interp C-1281). A transmission goes at the recommended rung, with no climb limit (corpus 0.36.0, P7-9 round 3; before, at most one above the last answered rung), except that after a failed trial it goes no higher than the answered rung until the peer answers, and that until a C_PDU of the connection has been confirmed (acknowledged in full) it goes no higher than the answered rung (coordinator ruling 2026-11-11, interp C-1293, corpus 0.41.0); a transmission of ARQ data above the answered rung is a trial, and a dts.ack_wait expiry with none of the D_PDUs of the last transmission that carried ARQ data acknowledged is a silent wait, whatever else the peer has sent (open question 16; coordinator ruling 2026-11-10, corpus 0.38.0; before, a wait with nothing heard from the peer since); a silent wait after a trial is a failed trial, which caps the peer one rung below it for tx_ceiling_initial of its transmissions to the peer, doubling on each repeat failure up to tx_ceiling_cap (design shape item 7, interp C-1281); tx_step_down_waits silent waits in a row step down one rung (plan 6.2, interp C-1282); an acknowledgement of one of those D_PDUs (or, after a transmission with no ARQ data, any answer, C-1250) ends the silence count and the step down and makes that transmission's rung the answered one when it is higher. Every data D_PDU to the peer is the first header to it in its transmission and carries SENDER-APPROACH, 0xB04 (interp C-1286); PADDING carries MAX-SEGMENT 255 (interp C-1271, C-1272). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150; WN 2 Long 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, WN 4 Long 50 bytes and 2400 ms (test data). The 29-byte DATA-ONLY needs two blocks at WN 2 Long (EOT 20, its PADDING in block 1 EOT 10, 10350 ms) and one at WN 4 Long (EOT and the PADDING's EOT ceil(2550 / 500) = 6, 3150 ms; one PADDING, 11 bytes). Each data transmission is one D_PDU, within one block of the MAX-SPEED rung, so for latency, and with no LOW-SPEED, MAX-SPEED stands in (interp C-1284, C-1285). dts.ack_wait_ms 60000; after our own transmission, a queue that refills with nothing heard goes through LBT rule 3, 3000 ms (K-0071, K-0074); after a burst addressed only to us, rule 1 (K-0067). Contention waits are seed 0's draws, uniform(16) x 3000 ms (K-0080). sis.soft_link_max_ms is set to 900000 (test data; corpus 0.41.0, before it was derived, 360000, A-0321), so the soft link's maximum hold does not end within the scenario. The link's first C_PDU: at 108000 'open' (FSN 0) goes at WN 2 Long, the answered rung, below the MAX-SPEED rung, since no C_PDU of the link has been confirmed yet (interp C-1293); it is not a trial. The peer's ACK-ONLY (RX LWE 1, EOT 10) at 124000 acknowledges it, so its C_PDU is confirmed and from then on a transmission may go above the answered rung; WN 2 Long stays the answered rung, dts.ttd is cancelled and the idle wait starts (A-0321: three answer waits, 180000). The scenario's first U_PDU is requested at 128000 (the idle wait cancelled, A-0320, dts.ttd restarted, and csma.vdcd_end 1000 for the rest of the ACK's predicted burst, K-0067), and its contention, seed 0's third draw, ends at 174000, when its first transmission goes; its FSNs start at 1 (before corpus 0.41.0 the scenario's first U_PDU made the call and took FSN 0, its first transmission at 108000). drc.table (corpus-format.md 6.1): ladder WN 2 Long, WN 4 Long, WN 4 Short, WN 6 Long (positions 0 to 3); no thresholds, so this node's own MAX-SPEED and LOW-SPEED never get a value (corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6) and the mixed rotation it sends each Ed4 peer it has heard is MAX-SEGMENT 255 alone (0xAFF; no SENDER-APPROACH has come, C-0956; interp C-1271, C-1272), with no top priority; sender constants tx_step_down_waits 2, tx_ceiling_initial 2, tx_ceiling_cap 4. At 174000 'ping' (FSN 1) goes at WN 4 Long, a trial (the link's first C_PDU is confirmed), and is answered by the ACK-ONLY at 183000 (RX LWE 2): WN 4 Long is now the answered rung and the trial succeeded. 'pong' (FSN 2, requested at 187000) goes at WN 4 Long, no longer a trial. Nothing is heard: the first dts.ack_wait expiry is one silent wait, and FSN 2 is retransmitted at WN 4 Long; the second in a row reaches tx_step_down_waits 2, so the sender steps down one rung by itself (plan 6.2, interp C-1282) and the next retransmission goes at WN 2 Long, below the recommendation, which going lower never exceeds (C-0894, plan 5.3), keeping its size (C-0549). The ACK-ONLY (RX LWE 3) answers it, which ends the step down. The connection is not lost: 2 answer waits, not 16 (C-1250). Re-derived in corpus 0.41.0 for interp C-1293: the link's first C_PDU 'open' is confirmed first, so each FSN is one higher and the times later than before.
